actors.name: Amara
actors.private_context: Amara is a professional who wants to earn more respect from her coworkers. She is aware of her current standing and has some ideas about how to improve it, but she hasn't decided on a specific plan.

actors.name: Amara's coworkers
actors.private_context: The coworkers are a group of individuals who work with Amara. They have their own perceptions of Amara based on past interactions, but no specific recent events have changed their views. They are open to updating their opinions based on future behavior.

shared_context: Amara and her coworkers work together in the same office environment. They interact regularly on work tasks and informal occasions. The quarter runs from October 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.

starting_events.description: The quarter begins. Amara and her coworkers are present at work.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least one coworker explicitly communicates increased respect for Amara (e.g., verbal praise, promotion recommendation, or similar observable act) before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
